_note: Why join, in four short points (designer feedback, 5 October 2026: the selling points in the spotlight). Shown in the blue band under the homepage title (title and text) and in the join call at the bottom of most pages (title only). The icons are the line icons of the reasons on Join (lib/line-icons.js), on discs in GoodPlanet's colours: lime, orange, pink, green. The words come from the five reasons on Join, shorter.

items.title: Be heard
items.text: Your ideas go to the people who manage the river.
items.text_fr: Tes idées vont aux personnes qui gèrent le fleuve.
items.text_nl: Je ideeën gaan naar de mensen die de rivier beheren.

items.title: Make friends
items.text: From three countries and all kinds of backgrounds.
items.text_fr: De trois pays et de tous les horizons.
items.text_nl: Uit drie landen en met allerlei achtergronden.

items.title: Learn by doing
items.text: Research, debate and present, in English.
items.text_fr: Recherche, débat et présentation, en anglais.
items.text_nl: Onderzoeken, debatteren en presenteren, in het Engels.

items.title: Have a good time
items.text_fr: Kayak, feux de camp et repas ensemble.
